verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete on the diff-scoped evidence. The MCP update entry point creates one server QueryBudget and supplies it to the WAC/ACP PodStore path; PodStore applies it both to variable-GRAPH write-set resolution and to the real in-place update while retaining unlimited compatibility entry points. Authorization-budget exhaustion returns before mutation, apply-budget exhaustion preserves the documented non-atomic error contract, and permission denial remains distinct. The focused tests exercise authorized real update paths, positive controls, authorization-stage and apply-stage exhaustion, mutation guards, WAC/ACP parity, and the WHERE-less boundary; they are not vacuous. Public API documentation and both affected skills match the implementation. LOAD is locally allowlist-gated and unsupported without an installed base, so the WHERE-focused MCP budget boundary does not introduce an unbounded remote-fetch path. No correctness, soundness, security, or injection issue is evident. With zero findings in rounds 2 and 3, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
